_comment: Tier-2 for dune::poisson (solver string not validated in Python). dune/fem/discretefunction/_solvers.py::femsolver forwards the `solver=` string unchecked as the C++ parameter 'linear.method'; the guard is DUNE's parameter reader, so a plausible name fails at scheme construction with an error naming a parameter the caller never wrote. The fixture harvests that message rather than trusting docs: it asserts the rejection, that the message still names 'fem.solver.linear.method', and that it still enumerates gmres/cg/bicgstab — then proves each advertised name actually solves. Verified by execution against dune-fem 2.12.0.2 on 2026-08-03: solver='conjugate_gradient' -> RuntimeError "ParameterInvalid [getEnumeration:.../dune/fem/io/parameter/reader.hh:300]: Parameter 'fem.solver.linear.method' invalid. Valid values are: gmres, cg, bicgstab". MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 passes 'cg', a name the enumeration accepts, in the slot where the base run passes the plausible-but-wrong 'conjugate_gradient'. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'bogus_solver_rejected=True', 'bogus_solver_names_the_parameter=True', 'dune_solver_enumeration_verified=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
